kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-host-share-key --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyHostShareKey

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。 
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared key whose information you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 要修改的主机共享密钥的ID
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the shared key
parameters.name: host_share_key_name

parameters.help_en:
The private key. Specify a Base64-encoded string.

Only Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) keys that are generated by using the ssh-keygen command and keys that are generated by using the Ed25519 algorithm are supported
parameters.help_zh:
私钥（Base64编码后的字符串）。
支持输入使用ssh-keygen命令生成的RSA密钥和Ed25519密钥
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en: The password of the private key. Specify a Base64-encoded string
parameters.help_zh: 私钥口令（Base64编码后的字符串）
parameters.name: pass_phrase

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
